key_findings.text_selection: selection-hook (MIT) is the only cross-app text selection monitor. Critical dependency.
key_findings.voice_stt: Moonshine 245M beats Whisper Large V3 (1.55B) in accuracy, CPU-only, streaming. Breakthrough for live dictation.
key_findings.text_injection: Clipboard + paste is the 95% solution. No single API works everywhere. Tiered fallback chain required.
key_findings.overlay_ui: Tauri v2 is ideal shell: 5MB bundle, always-on-top, system tray, global shortcuts, transparent windows.
key_findings.rag_framework: LlamaIndex for retrieval + Qdrant for vector DB + BGE-M3 for embeddings + Semantic Scholar API for papers.
key_findings.evidence_finding: OpenScholar (Nature 2026) outperforms GPT-4o with non-hallucinating citations. Scite classifies supporting/contradicting.
key_findings.paraphrasing: T5_Paraphrase_Paws (MIT, ~500MB) for local paraphrase generation. 4 lines of inference code.
key_findings.synonyms: Datamuse API (free, no key) + NLTK WordNet (offline).
key_findings.wayland_problem: xdotool broken on Wayland. ydotool/dotool work but need root. Clipboard+paste is most reliable fallback.
key_findings.chromium_caveat: Google Docs hides accessibility tree behind --force-renderer-accessibility flag. OCR + clipboard injection is fallback.
